newsitem.title: UK: CSFB adds 25 million marks to Ecuador-linked bond.
newsitem.headline: CSFB adds 25 million marks to Ecuador-linked bond.

text.p: The following bond, announced earlier by lead manager Credit Suisse First Boston, has been increased from 100 million marks to 125 million marks.
There are new issue and reoffer prices.
